name: Movistar Colombia
body: HSTS, no-referrer, a Permissions-Policy, and framing limited by CSP frame-ancestors. But X-Frame-Options is set to nosniff, a value meant for X-Content-Type-Options, which is missing.
lesson: Send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN. Recheck headers after config changes.
summary: www.movistar.com.co scores 71 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 23 are at risk, and 21 pass. Fix first: the start page tells search engines not to index it.

fix.title: The start page tells search engines not to index it
fix.fix: Remove noindex from pages that should be found, and keep it only on private or duplicate pages.

fix.title: 53 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /comparadores, /atencion-al-cliente/asistencia-tecnica, /atencion-al-cliente/radica-tu-pqr and 14 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: X-Content-Type-Options is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers may guess a file's type and run it as script. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager, TikTok Pixel, Hotjar appear in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: Lighthouse scores performance 34/100 on mobile
fix.evidence: Lighthouse 13.5.0 on a simulated mid-range phone over slow 4G: Largest Contentful Paint 10.7 s, Total Blocking Time 1796 ms, Cumulative Layout Shift 0, Speed Index 5.9 s.
fix.fix: Open PageSpeed Insights for this URL and work through its opportunities, largest savings first.

fix.title: 9 pages have no canonical link
fix.evidence: /, /pymes, /empresas, /comparadores and 5 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking signals.
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
